summary: STORE-012B · MOODBOARD V2.1 Working Moodboard™ verified end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest PASS against the live preview backend with admin@moodfordesign.com / Blueprint2024! and journey 8bb7a3b4-02af-4040-8420-37a254713899. Verified: (a) POST /api/journeys/{jid}/working-moodboards/from-concept/{cb_id} returns moodboard_id + derived_at, and on first creation also returns created=true, sections=['vision','materials','products','atmosphere','notes'], element_count>=15; (b) Idempotency — second POST returns created=false with the SAME moodboard_id; (c) /working-payload returns 5 ordered sections with English titles (Vision/Materials/Products/Atmosphere/Design Notes), every element.content is a parsed dict carrying approval_status ∈ {suggested,discussed,approved,rejected} default 'suggested'; (d) Vision section has a 'headline' text variant; Materials section elements carry the NFC-ready triple content.entity_id + material_id + brand_id; Atmosphere images expose content.media_id; Notes has an editable text element (editable:true); (e) working_seed in ai_metadata carries source_concept_id, direction_name, derived_at, mode='working', sections, style_dna_snapshot, color_palette, generator='store-012b'; (f) /project-brain returns moodboard_id/journey_id/client/project/discovery{style_dna,material_dna,project_profile,investment_profile,atmosphere_signals}/concept_pulse{has_shared_set,preferred_direction,ranking,feedback_summary}/recommended_next_action{key,headline,hint} AND the raw response NEVER contains 'client_alignment_score'; (g) PATCH /api/moodboard-elements/{eid}/approval-status with 'approved' updates content.approval_status (verified via re-GET of working-payload), 'totally-bogus' returns 422; (h) /client/moodboards/{id}/presentation never leaks 'client_alignment_score' and never contains any 'approval_*' key (admin call is correctly RBAC-gated but body is still invariant-safe); (i) /journeys/{jid}/working-moodboards lists the generated moodboard; (j) Regression on STORE-011 discover-brief, STORE-012A concept-directions, STORE-012D concept-pulse + invariant — all green. Frontend: All required data-testids present at /studio/moodboards/working/47821aa0-50c0-4ff6-ae5f-e6dccf0391e7 — working-moodboard root, wmb-section-vision/materials/products/atmosphere/notes, project-brain + brain-next-action + brain-preferred, 80 approval chips (20 elements × 4 chips), 80 element cards, wmb-toggle-mode. Clicking 'Approved' chip optimistically applies .is-on class to the chip AND .wmb-el--approved (green border) class to the card. Toggling switches URL to ?mode=presentation, hides project-brain, and renders present-vision, present-atmosphere, present-materials, present-highlights, present-next-steps. present-products is hidden in this seed (no approved products yet, per the 'if any' spec). At /studio/journey/{jid}/discover the new Concept-card CTAs work: 26 cards show data-testid=dbe-generate-working-{cb_id} and 1 card already shows data-testid=dbe-open-working-{cb_id} (the existing derived board), exactly matching the spec.

issues: ~13 missing it-IT keys for auth.login.* / nav.* (pre-existing, not introduced by STORE-012B). Console noise only.
React warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' coming from the navigation/i18n layer (pre-existing, not from WorkingMoodboardPage).

critical_code_review_comments: routers/working_moodboards.py is ~650 LOC and self-contained — within the 700-line guideline.

client_moodboard_presentation strips approval_* keys via prefix match. Good. The same loop also normalises mediatype etc. Consider adding the same prefix-strip in /working-payload if/when this endpoint is reused beyond the studio UI (today it intentionally includes approval_status, which is correct).
The hardcoded English section titles ('Vision','Materials','Products','Atmosphere','Design Notes') will not be localised — fine for V2.1, but worth a TODO since the studio is multi-locale.

generate_working_moodboard inserts moodboard_pages, moodboard_elements and a timeline event in three separate Supabase calls. There is no transaction wrapper — if the second call fails the moodboard row is orphaned. Low risk but worth wrapping in a try/except with cleanup, or move to a stored procedure.

Idempotency check loops over all journey moodboards in Python and inspects ai_metadata.working_seed.source_concept_id. With many concepts this is O(N) per request. Consider a partial index on ai_metadata->'working_seed'->>'source_concept_id' if scale grows.
_fetch_material_entities/_fetch_product_entities/_fetch_media silently return {} on exception — masks DB errors. Log at WARN level instead of swallowing.

Concept Card 'Generate Working Moodboard™' CTAs: 26 generate buttons on a single discover page means a chatty UI. If a user clicks the wrong card, the system happily creates 26 boards (one per click on different cards). Consider rate-limiting / confirmation dialog, or batch from the preferred-only path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on every spec data-testid (root, 5 sections, project-brain + sub-testids, 80 approval chips, toggle, optimistic approve class + card class, presentation-mode sections, Concept-card generate/open CTAs)

seed_data_creation: No new seed needed. Test reused existing journey 8bb7a3b4-02af-4040-8420-37a254713899 + the preferred Concept Board pulled live from /concept-pulse, and verified the existing Working Moodboard 47821aa0-50c0-4ff6-ae5f-e6dccf0391e7 in the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: STORE-012B fully verified. The pytest suite test_iter220_store012b_working_moodboard.py auto-picks the preferred concept board id from /api/journeys/{jid}/concept-pulse, then asserts the full lifecycle: generate → idempotent re-POST → working-payload structure → NFC-ready material triple → approval PATCH (valid+422) → project-brain shape & invariant → client-presentation invariant → list endpoint → STORE-011/012A/012D regression. The auth flow returns the token at data.session.access_token. Frontend: WorkingMoodboardPage testids are working-moodboard, wmb-section-{vision|materials|products|atmosphere|notes}, project-brain, brain-next-action, brain-preferred, wmb-approval-{suggested|discussed|approved|rejected}-{element_id}, wmb-toggle-mode, and presentation-mode siblings present-{vision|atmosphere|materials|products|highlights|next-steps} (present-products only renders if approved products exist; present-highlights only if any approved element exists). Discover-brief Concept cards expose dbe-generate-working-{cb_id} or dbe-open-working-{cb_id} depending on existence.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in STORE-012B. The only failing artefact (present-products absent in presentation mode) is correct-by-design — the seed has zero approved product elements, and the spec explicitly says products+highlights only render when approved elements exist.
